assets.prompt: Create one production concept sheet for a small open hardcover book prop for Bubu, the exact pink rounded little character in the attached canonical reference. Use case stylized-concept. Six clean panels on neutral light gray. Top row: independent book front, side, rear, and 45 degree product views, no character in these panels. Bottom row: two static contact studies showing canonical Bubu holding the same open book low below its mouth with both tiny paws, front and 45 degree. Preserve character silhouette, tiny ears, small feet, facial landmarks and short paws. Book: simple muted teal hard cover, warm ivory page block, softly beveled corners, plain blank pages, modest spine seam, no lettering, logos or decoration. Modelable real thickness, two open page halves, consistent geometry across views; book width about 40 percent of body width. Static prop fit only, no new animation or action sequence. Keep all objects fully visible with ample margins. No extra accessories, no background scene.
assets.review: Original scene had extra side paw and duplicated front/rear book; directed edits remove side paw and show inside pages vs outer cover. Selected has two hands and clear quarter fit. Character pixels are never runtime body.
